146 grub mtha'i bstan bcos mi shig rdo rje'i bo cha/sngon song gi 'phags pa de yang yin dbu ma pa'ang yin pa zhig dang / mdo sde pa'i rtogs pa sngon song gi 'phags pa/ de yang yin dbu ma pa ma yin pa yin pa zhig dang bcas tha snyad du gnyis su phye rung ngo / de'i sgo nas bye smra'i rtogs pa sngon song gi 'phags pa sogs la'ang tha snyad du rigs 'gre bar bya'o/de'ang tshogs sbyor gnyis su gtso bor sems tsam pa'i lam sgom pa sngon song gi sgo nas rim gyis stong nyid rtogs pa'i theg chen gyi 'phags pa kun tha snyad du sems tsam pa'i rtogs pa sngon song gi 'phags pa dang / tshogs sbyor gnyis su gtso bor mdo sde pa'i lam sgom pa sngon song gi sgo nas stong nyid rtogs pa'i 'phags pa kun tha snyad du mdo sde pa'i rtogs pa sngon song gi 'phags pa dang tshogs sbyor gnyis su gtso bor bye smra'i lam sgom pa sngon du song ba'i sgo nas stong nyid rtogs pa'i 'phags pa kun tha snyad du bye smra'i rtogs pa sngon song gi 'phags pa bcas yin no/kha cig na re/ grangs can pa'i lugs la zhugs pa sngon du song ba'i byang sems 'phags pa de tha snyad du grangs can pa'i 'phags pa yin par thal/tshogs sbyor gnyis su gtso bor bye brag smra ba'i lam sgoms pa sngon du song ba'i byang sems 'phags pa de tha snyad du bye smra'i rtogs pa sngon song gi 'phags pa yin pa'i phyir/ zer na/ khyab pa ma nges/ rtags tha snyad du sla/ rtsa ba'i gsal bar 'dod mi nus te/ mu stegs pa la tha snyad du dge sbyong med pa'i phyir/ rtags der thal/ ji skad du/ phyi rol pa la dge sbyong med/ / ces tha snyad du de ltar gsungs pa'i phyir/kha cig na re/ rnam rtog rnam rtog tsam/ du 'dzin pa'i 'dzin pa de chos can/ khyod tha snyad du spang bya yin par thal/ khyod tha snyad du shes sgrib phra mo'am khyod tha snyad du chos kyi bdag 'dzin phra mo yin pa'i phyir/ zer na khyab

dbu ma pa'i rnam bzhag bstan pa/ 147pa ma nges/ de der thal/ mi pham padma dkar po'i zhal snga nas/ rnam rtog rnam rtog go zhes lta ba chos kyi bdag 'dzin yin la/ zhes tha snyad du gsungs pa'i phyir/ rtsa ba'i sasal bar 'dod na/ rnam rtog rnam rtog tsam du 'dzin pa'i 'dzin pa de tha snyad du spang bya ru ma nges par thal/ rnam rtog rnam rtog tsam du 'dzin pa'i 'dzin pa de tha snyad du las dang po ba sogs kyi gnas skabs la ltos te spang bya ma yin par tha snyad du 'jog rigs shing /rnam rtog rnam rtog tsam du 'dzin pa'i 'dzin pa de tha snyad du mthar thug gi theg chen gyi lam gyi dgag bya yin zhes gzhan ngor phye rigs pa'i phyir/rtags zur dang po tha snyad du grub ste/ spyod 'jug las/ ji ltar mthong thos shes pa dag / 'dir ni dgag par bya min te/ / zhes tha snyad du gsungs pa'i phyir/ rtags zur phyi ma tha snyad du grub ste/ slob pa ba'i ngag tu gyur pa'i lung chos rnams kyang tha snyad du mthar thug gi theg pa chen po'i lam la ltos te dgag bya yin pa gang zhig rnam rtog rnam rtog tsam du 'dzin pa'i 'dzin pa de gzhan ngor mthar thug gi theg chen gyi lam gyi dor bya yin pa'i phyir/ rtags dang po der thal/ mnyam med sgam po pa'i zhal snga nas/bstan pa'i chos ni ming gi tshogs dang yi ge'i tshogs yin pas lam bgrod zin nas gzings ltar spang bya yin/ zhes tha snyad du gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang 'khor gsum bden par 'dzin pa'i 'dzin pa de tha snyad du shes sgrib tu gyur pa'i spang bya yin no/kha cig na re/ theg chen gyi mthong lam mnyam bzhag pa chos can/khyod kyis tha snyad du bum pa rtogs ma myong par thal zer na/ gsal bar ma grub bo/ gnad kyi don ni/ de chos can/ khyod kyis gzhan ngor bum pa rtogs myong yang / khyod kyis rang dus na tha snyad du khyod kyis bum pa rtogs

146 grub mtha'i bstan bcos mi shig rdo rje'i go cha/ma myong ngo /kho na re/ chos gcig gi stong gi stong nyid rtogs na tha snyad du chos thams cad kyi stong nyid rtogs dgos par thal/ nyan rang dgra bcom pas gzhan ngor chos gcig gi stong gi stong nyid rtogs pa ma zad tha snyad du nyan rang dgra bcom pas chos thams cad kyi steng gi stong nyid rtogs pa'i phyir/zer na/ khyab pa ma nges/kho na re/ khyod kyis chos gcig gi stong gi stong nyid rtogs na khyod kyis tha snyad du chos thams cad kyi stong gi stong nyid rtogs dgos par thal/ khyod chos gcig gi stong gi don dam dngos su rtogs pa po yin na khyod kyis tha snyad du chos thams cad kyi steng gi don dam rtogs dgos pa'i phyir zer na/ khyab pa ma nges/ rtags der thal/ mdo ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ gcig gis kyang ni thams cad shes/ / gcig gis kyang ni thams cad mthong / / zhes tha snyad du de ltar gsungs pa'i phyir/ rtsa ba'i gsal bar 'dod mi nus so/khyod kyis stong nyid dngos su rtogs pa dang khyod kyis stong nyid rtogs pa gnyis la khyad par tha snyad du 'jog rgyu yod do/kha cig na re/ rdzun tshig chos can/ khyod tha snyad du bden pa yin par thal/ khyod tha snyad du kun rdzob kyi bden pa yin pa'i phyir/ zer na khyab pa ma nges/ de chos can/ der thal/ khyod tha snyad du dngos po yin pa'i phyir/ gsal bar 'dod na/ de chos can/ de ma yin par thal/khyod tha snyad du rdzun pa yin pa'i phyir/kha cig na re/ 'o na so skye'i bden tshig chos can/ tha snyad du bden pa ma yin par thal/ tha snyad du rdzun pa yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/der thal/ tha snyad du rdzun par grub pa yin pa'i phyir/ zer na khyab pa ma

dbu ma pa'i rnam bzhag bstan pa/ 149nges/ de chos can/ der thal/ khyod tha snyad du don dam la bltos te bsru zhing rdzun pa yin pa gang zhig tha snyad du 'dus byas yin pa'i phyir/khyab pa tha snyad du nges te/ mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ 'dus byas thams cad bsru ba'i chos/ des na de dag rdzun par gsungs/ / zhes tha snyad du de ltar gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na gangs can pa la la ltar bden pa dang rdzun pa gnyis kyi gzhi mthun yod pa ni tha snyad du 'dir mi 'thad do/kha cig na re/ don dam chos can/ tha snyad du bden grub yin par thal/ tha snyad du bden pa yin pa'i phyir zer na/ khyab pa ma nges/rtags gzhan ngor sla/ gsal bar 'dod mi nus te/ tha snyad du bden par grub na tha snyad du rang bzhin gyis bden par grub dgos pa gang zhig kun rdzobakyi bden par grub na rang bzhin gyis bden par grub pas ma khyab pa'i phyir/ kha cig na re/ sems kyi ngo bo tha snyad du sems yin pa'i phyir zer na/rtags ma grub ste/ sems kyi ngo bo tha snyad du don dam yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin tha snyad du don dam yin pa'i phyir/der thal/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin tha snyad du rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stod nyid yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ ji skad du/ de bzhin chos rnams thams cad kyi/ / rang bzhin stong pa nyid du 'dod/ / ces tha snyad du gsungs pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang sems kyi ngo bo'am sems kyi rang bzhin tha snyad du'ang sems ma yin par thal/ sems kyi rang bzhin de tha snyad du don dam pa'i phyag chen yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ chos rnams kun gyi rang bzhin de tha snyad du don dam pa'i phyag chen yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/mdo ting 'dzin rgyal po las/ chos rnams kun gyi rang bzhin phyag rgya che/zhes tha snyad du de ltar gsungs pa'i phyir/

150 grub mtha'i bstan bcos mi shig rdo rje'i go cha/kho na re/ sems kyi rang bzhin tha snyad du sems yin par thal/'byung ba gsum par gyur pa'i tsha zhing sreg pa de tha snyad du mdo sde pa sogs kyi lugs la tha snyad du me'i rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ tha snyad du mdo sde pa sogs kyi lugs la 'byung ba gsum par gyur pa'i tsha zhing sreg pa de tha snyad du mdo sde pa sogs kyi lugs la me'i rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir zer na/khyabapa ma nges/ rtags der thal/ ji skad du/ me yi rang bzhin tsha ba dang / bu ram rang bzhin mngar ba dang / de bzhin chos rnams thams cad kyi/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid du 'dod/ ces pa'i skabs kyi snga rgol ba khyod cag gis tha snyad du me'i rang bzhin tsha zhing sreg pa ru 'dod pa ltar du nged dbu ma pa'i lugs la tha snyad du chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin stong pa nyid du 'thad do zhes tha snyad du de ltar bstan pa'i phyir ro/ rtsa bar ma grub pa'i tshul tha snyad du sla/kho na re/ 'byung ba gsum par gyur pa'i tsha zhing sreg pa chos can/thasnyad du me'i rang bzhin yin par thal/ tha snyad du me'i rang bzhin kun rdzob pa de yin pa'i phyir zer na/ khyab pa ma nges/ 'dir me'i rang bzhin dang me gnyis ka yin pa zhig 'jog rgyu yod pa ma yin no/ me'i mtshan nyid yin na tha snyad du me'i rang bzhin yin mi dgos so/ 'dir chos kyi bdag med rags pa de tha snyad du med dgag yin yang chos kyi bdag med rags pa de rnam kun mchog ldan gyi stong nyid dang bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i chos nyid bcas tha snyad du'ang ma yin no/ 'di la dgongs te dpal ldan zla bas theg pa chen po bstan pa ni/ chos kyi bdag med pa tsam 'ba' zhig ston pa ma yin gyi/ zhes dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i chos nyid kyang yin no/zhes tha snyad du de ltar gsungs so/

dbu ma pa'i rnam bzhag bstan pa/ 151kha cig na re/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rang ngo la tha snyad du snod bcud kyi dngos po kun chos sku yin par thal/ snod bcud kyi dngos po kun gdags pa'i don du sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rang ngo la chos sku yin pa'i phyir zer na/ khyab pa ma nges/kha cig na re/ bum pa'i steng gi chos nyid chos can/ khyod tha snyad du chos sku dang gzugs sku gnyis su phye ba'i chos sku yin par thal/ khyod tha snyad duchos sku yin pa'i phyir zer na/ khyab pa ma nges/ de chos can/ der thal/ khyod tha snyad du chos nyid yin pa'i phyir/kha cig na re/ mchog gi sprul sku chos can/ khyod tha snyad du chos sku dang gzugs sku gnyis su phye ba'i chos sku yin par thal/ khyod tha snyad du chos sku yin pa'i phyir zer na/ khyab pa ma nges/ de chos can/ der thal/khyod tha snyad du don dam yin pa'i phyir/kha cig na re/ chos thams cad don dam pa la chos sku dang sangs rgyas gnyis ka yin par thal/ chos thams cad gdags pa'i don du don dam pa la chos sku dang sangs rgyas gnyis ka yin pa'i phyir zer na/ khyab pa ma nges/rtags tha snyad du sla/ rtsa ba'i gsal bar 'dod mi nus te/ don dam pa la gang yang ma yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig na re/ chos thams cad sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rang ngo la chos sku yin par thal/ chos thams cad sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i dag pa'i gzigs ngo la kun rdzob tu chos sku yin pa'i phyir zer na/khyab pa ma nges/kha cig na re/ khyi rgan rgya bo'i steng gi don dam chos can/ khyod tha snyad du dag pa gnyis ldan gyi chos sku yin par thal/ khyod gdags pa'i don du don dam pa la dag pa gnyis ldan gyi chos sku yin pa'i phyir zer na/ khyab

152 grub mtha'i bstan bcos mi shig rdo rje'i go cha/pa ma nges/ de der thal/ ma/rtson po byams pas/ 'di la gsal bya ci yang med/ ces tha snyad du gsungs pa'i phyir/gdags pa'i don du don dam pa la'am gdags pa'i don du sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rang ngo la chos can/ nyon mongs nyon mongs ma yin par thal/ nyon mongs ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ 'di la dgongs te bde bshegs phag mo gru pas/ nyon mongs dug gsum 'bar ba de/ / ye shes rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor yin/ / zhes dang / do hā las/ nyon mongs ye shes chen po ste/ / nags la me bzhin rnal 'byor grogs/ / zhes tha snyad du de ltar gsungs so/ gdags pa'i don du don dam pa la'am gdags pa'i don du sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rang ngo la chos can/ bdag 'dzin bdag 'dzin ma yin par thal/ bdag 'dzin ye shes yin pa'i phyir/ 'di la dgongs te/ rje phag gru pas/ bdag 'dzin nyon mongs rba klong de/ / dus gsum sangs rgyas ye shes yin/ / zhes tha snyad du de ltar gsungs so/ gdags pa'i don du don dam pa la'am gdags pa'i don du sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rang ngo la chos can/ rnam rtog rnam rtog ma yin te/ rnam rtog chos sku yin pa'i phyir/ 'di la dgongs te rje padma dkar po'i zhal snga nas/ mdor na rnam rtog chos sku yin zhes pa'i/ / gtam 'di nges don gtan la 'bebs pa'i dus/ / zhes dang / chos rgyal zla 'od gzhon nus/ rgyun chad med pa'i rnam rtog 'di/ / ye shes yin par da gzod shes/ / zhes dang / rje phag gru pas/ rnam rtog bzung 'dzin rba rlabs de/ / dus gsum 'gyur med sangs rgyas yin/ / zhes tha snyad du gsungs so/ gdags pa'i don du don dam la'am gdags pa'i don du sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i dag pa'i gzigs ngo la chos can/ 'khor ba dang sdug bsngal can gyi sems can kun

dbu ma pa'i rnam bzhag bstan pa/ 153go rim bzhin du 'khor ba dang sdug bsngal can gyi semasacan ma/ yin te/'khor ba dang sdug bsngal can gyi sem/sa can gnyis ka mya ngan las 'das pa'i sangs rgyas yin pa'i phyir/ 'di la dgongs te dpal ldan phag gru pas/'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho de/ mya ngan 'das pa'i khang bzang yin/ /zhes dang / mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ 'khor ba mya ngan 'das pa las/ /khyad par cung zad yod ma yin/ zhes sogs tha snyad du gsungs so/'di lta bu la dgongs te gzhan phyogs kyi mkhas pa chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis kyang / dmyal ba'i lcags bsregs sa gzhi de/ / yang dag don gyi 'og min yin/ / tsha grang sdug bsngal 'bar ba de/ / spros dang bral ba'i chos sku yin/ / zhes sogs tha snyad du gsungs so/ gdags pa'i don du sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i dag pa'i gzigs ngo la chos can/ mdor na snang grags kyi chos thams cad chos ma yin par thal/ snang grags kyi chos thams cad chos sku yin pa'i phyir/ 'di la dgongs te rje zla 'od gzhon nus/brtag pa'i bag chags snang grags 'di/ / chos sku yin par brtsir gyis bzung / zhes tha snyad du gsungs so/kha cig gis sangs rgyas yin na tha snyad du'ang yod med gnyis las 'das pa yin dgos pa'i gnad 'di ma rtogs pa'i gnad kyis kha cig gis sangs rgyas 'phags pa dang rnam mkhyen gnyis ka mi rtag pa ru tha snyad du khas len dgos song ba yin no/ gnad 'di lta bu tha snyad du rtogs na gzhan grags kyi sgo nas dag pa'i gzigs ngor phung khams gshegs pa gshegs ma //kā /ḍirji sngags rdo rje theg pa'i gnad du ma zhig tha snyad du rim gyis rtogs

154drug pa/ rgya chen sgyu maltabu'i chos tshul la gnas te mjug yongs su rdzogasu pa'i bya ba bstan pa/rgya chen sgyu ma lta bu'i chos tshul la gnas te mjug yongs su rdzogs pa'i bya ba bstan pa la gnyis te/ theg pa dang nang pa'i grub mtha' smra ba'i dbye bsdu zhar byung du bstan pa/ tshigs su bcad pa'i me tog sel mar bkram pa'i sgo nas bstan bcos chen po'i mjug bsdu ba'o/dang po/ theg pa dang nang pa'i grub mtha' smra ba'i dbye bsdu zhar byung du bstan pa/dang po ni/ 'dir nang par gyur pa'i sangs rgyas pa'i theg pa yin na/nyan thos kyi theg pa dang / rang rgyal gyi theg pa dang / theg chen gyi theg pa stede gsum po gang rung zhig yin dgos te/ nang pa'i theg pa gsum las gzhan pa'i nang pa'i theg pa bzhi pa phan chad med pa'i phyir/ 'di la dgongs te/ rdo rje snying 'grel las/ nyan thos pa dang rang rgyal 'dir/ / theg pa chen po gsum pa ste/ / sangs rgyas pa yi bzhi pa dang / /thub pa'i gzhung ni lnga pa med/ / ces dang / slob dpon a ba ju ti pas/ theg pa ni gsum ste/ nyan thos kyi theg pa dang / rang sangs

mjug yongs su rdzogs pa'i bya ba bstan pa/ 155rgyas kyi theg pa/ theg pa chen po zhes bya'o/ zhes gsungs so/ / nang pa'i grub mtha' smra ba'i gang zag yin na bye brag smra ba dang / mdo sde pa dang /sems tsam pa dang / dbu ma pa ste de bzhi po gang rung yin dgos par thal// bye mdo dbu sems bzhi las gzhan pa 'i nang pa'i grub mtha' smra ba'i skyes bu zhig med pa'i phyir/ 'di la dgongs te rdo rje snying 'grel las/ de nas bye brag smra ba'i gzhung / / de nas mdo sde pa zhes 'gyur/ / rang chos rnam shes smra ba dang / / de nas dbu ma'i gzhung zhes bya/ / zhes dang / yang de nyid las/ thub pa'i gzhung ni lnga pa med/ / ces dang / dgyes rdor gyi gzhung las/ de nas bye brag smra ba bstan/ / mdo sde pa yang de bzhin no//de nas rnal 'byor spyod pa nyid/ / de yi rjes su dbu ma bstan/ zhes dang / / rigs ldan grags pas/ bye brag smra dang mdo sde pa/ / rnal 'byor spyod dang dbu ma ru/ / 'gyur ro/ zhes dang / / rdo rje a ra la'i rgyud las/ kha cig pha rol phyin pa'i tshul/ / kha cig bye brag smra ba'i lam// kha cig tu ni mdo sde pa/ kha cig tu ni rnam shes nyid/ / ces dang /slob dpon a ba rtsu ti pas/ gnas pa bzhi ste/ bye brag tu smra ba dang /mdo sde pa dang / rnal 'byor spyod pa dang / dbu ma pa'i dbye bas so/zhes dang / slob dpon lhan skyes rdo rjes kyang / mdo sde bye brag smra rnam rigadabu ma'i/ zhes sogs gsungs so/kha cig na re/ nang pa'i theg pa chos can/ khyod theg chen gyi theg pa dang / rang rgyal gyi theg pa dang / nyan thos kyi theg pa ste de gsum po gang rung zhig yin par thal/ khyod nang par gyur pa'i sangs rgyas pa'i theg pa yin pa'i phyir/ zer na/ shin tu 'dod do/ nang pa'i theg pa de nyan thos kyi theg pa dang / rang rgyal gyi theg pa dang / theg chen gyi theg pa ste de

156 grub mtha'i bstan bcos mi shig rdo rje'i go cha/gsum gang yin ngos bzung zer na/ gcig tu ma nges so/'o na khyod nyon cig gzhi grub na rtag dngos gang rung yin mi dgos par thal lo/ gsal bar ma grub na/ 'o na gzhi grub na rtag dngos gang yin dgos khyod kyis ngos zungs shig go don 'grigs/ 'dir nyan thos kyi dgra bcom pa'i rtogs pa sngon du song ba'i byang sems tshogs lam pa'i rgyud kyi myang 'das de theg pa ma yin pa dang myang 'das gnyis kyi gzhi mthun no/kha cig na re/ nang pa'i grub mtha' smra ba'i gang zag chos can/ bye brag smra ba dang / mdo sde pa dang / sems tsam pa dang / dbu ma pa ste bzhi po gang rung yin par thal/ zer na/ 'dod do/ de de bzhi po gang yin zer na/ gcig tu ma nges so/kha cig na re/ bram ze chen po sa ra ha pa chos can/ bye mdo dbu sems bzhi po gang rung ma yin par thal/ khyod gsang sngags pa yin pa'i phyir zer na/ khyab pa ma nges/ rtsa ba'i gsal bar 'dod na/ de chos /na/ ngaḥd bye mdo dbu sems bzhi po gang rung du thal/ khyod dbu ma pa na paḍi ci/ /na re/ nang pa yin la chos thams cad bden par ma grub par 'dod cing stong nyid med dgag las lhag pa'i stong nyid tha snyad du'ang 'jog rgyu med par snying nas yid ches pa'i grub mtha' smra ba'i gang zag chos can/khyod nang pa'i grub mtha' phyogs mthun smra ba'i gang zag ma yin par thal/khyod nang pa'i grub mtha' smra ba'i gang zag ma yin pa'i phyir zer na/ khyab pa ma nges/ de chos can/ der thal/ khyod bye brag smra ba dang mdo sde pa dang /sems tsam pa dang / dbu ma pa ste de bzhi po gang rung ma yin pa'i phyir/rtsa bar 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod nang pa'i grub mtha' phyogs mthun

mjug yongs su rdzogs ngu 'i bya ba bstan pa/ 157smra ba'i gang zag yin par thal / khyod dbu ma pa'i grub mtha' phyogs ma/thun smra ba'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/kha cig na re/ chos thams cad bden par ma grub par 'dod cing stong nyid med dgag las lhag pa'i stong nyid tha snyad du'ang 'jog rgyu med par snying nas yid ches pa'i sgo nas grub mtha' smra ba'i nang pa de chos can/ khyod nang pa phyogs mthun tsam las nang pa ma yin par thal/ khyod nang pa'i grub mtha' phyogs mthun smra ba'i gang zag tsam las khyod nang pa'i grub mtha' smra ba'i gang zag ma yin pa'i phyir/ zer na/ khyab pa ma nges/ gsal bar 'dod na/ de chos can/ khyod nang pa yin par thal/ khyod chos 'di pa yin pa'i phyir/ khyab pa nges te/ chos 'di pa dang / nang pa dang sangs rgyas pa rnams rnam grangs yin pa'i phyir/kha cig na re/ bye mdo dbu sems bzhi po gang rung yin na nang pa'i grub mtha' smra bzhin pa'i gang zag yin dgos pa thal/ nang pa'i grub mtha' smra ba'i gang zag yin na bye mdo dbu sems bzhi po gang rung yin dgos pa'i phyir/ zer na/ khyab pa ma nges/ rtags der thal/ bye mdo dbu sems bzhi po gang rung ma yin pa'i nang pa'i grub mtha' smra ba'i gang zag lnga pa zhig mi srid pa'i phyir/ 'di la dgongs te/ rdo rje snying 'grel las/lnga pa thub pa'i dgongs pa min/ zhes gsungs so/ rtsa ba'i gsal bar 'dod mi nus te/ gnyid stug tsam la gnas pa'i mdo sde pa de gnyid stug tsam la gnas bzhin pa'i skabs su gnyid stug tsam la gnas pa'i mdo sde pa de grub mtha' gang yang mi smra bzhin pa'i mdo sde pa yin pa'i phyir/kha cig na re/ nang par gyur pa'i sangs rgyas pa'i lugs de bye brag smra ba'i lugs yin par thal/ bye brag smra ba'i lugs de nang par gyur pa'i

156 grub mtha'i bstan bcos mi shig rdo rje'i go cha/sangs rgyas pa'i dman lugs yin pa'i phyir/ zer na khyab gsal ma nges so/kha cig na re/ gnyid stug tsam la gnas pa'i mdo sde pa de gnyid stugs po la gnas bzhin pa'i skabs su gnyid stugs tsam la gnas pa'i mdo sde pa chos can/ khyod mdo sde pa ma yin par thal/ khyod nang pa'i grub mtha' smra bzhin pa'i gang zag ma yin pa'i phyir/ zer na/ khyab pa ma nges/de chos can/ der thal/ khyod grub mtha' gang yang mi smra bzhin pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ rtags sla/kha cig na re/ rang rgyal chos can/ khyod nang pa ma yin par thal/khyodabye mdo dbu sems bzhi po gang rung ma yin pa'i phyir zer na/ khyab pa ma nges pa'i lan no/ de chos can/ der thal/ khyod theg 'bring pa yin pa'i phyir/ de gong gi gsal bar 'dod mi nus so/ 'dir rang rgyal chos can/ khyod nang pa'i grub mtha' phyogs mthun smra ba'i gang zag yin par thal/ khyod rigs smra'i mdo sde pa'i grub mtha' phyogs mthun smra ba'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ rtags khyab sla/ de chos can/ khyod nang pa'i grub mtha' smra ba'i gang zag ma yin par thal/ khyod bye mdo dbu sems bzhi po gang rung ma yin pa'i phyir/ rtags khyab sla/ de chos can/ khyod nang pa yin par thal/ khyod rang rgyal yin pa'i phyir/ rtags khyab sla/

mjug yongs su rdzogs pa'i bya ba bstan pa/ 159gnyis pa/ chigs su bcad pa'i me rtag sel ma bkram pa'i sgo nas bstan btsos chen mo'i mjug bsdu ba/tshigs su bcad pa me tog sem ma bkram pa'i sgo nas bstan bcos chen mo'i mjug bsdu ba ni/ mtha' med srid pa'i mya ngam thang chen na/ /'dir snang mig rgyu'i chu bo'i rjes snyegs nas/ / rnam grol bdud rtsi nyams su ma myong ba'i/ / gdul bya'i ri dwags skom pas gdung ba la/ / byams dang snying rje'i chu 'dzin rab dkrigs nas/ / zab rgyas chos kyi 'brug sgra sgrog bzhin du/ / phan bde'i gru char sib sib 'bebs mdzad pa'i/ / skyabs gcig drin can bla mas dge legs rtsol/ /bka' dang bstan bcos mang du thos na yang / / de'i don nyams su len la mi mkho zhes/ / sgom thabs gzhan nas 'tshol ba'i ngal ba 'di/ / gsung rabs gdams par ma shar 'di yi skyon/ /grub thob rgya mtsho'i snying gtam spel ba yi/ / man ngag zab mor dgos med smra ba ni/ / gsang chen rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i srog gi snying / /rtsis med yan gar bor ba'i rtags su gsal/ / des na thar 'dod blo gsal gzhon nu rnams/ /thos tsam nyid nas sgom la mi smod cing / / sgom tsam nyid nas thos bsam mi spang bar/ / thos bsam 'gal med khyer shes shin tu gces/ /dang po gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i gnad la sbyong / / bar du de'i don bsam pas lan brgyar dpyad/ / tha mar bsam don sgom la sbyor ba 'di/ /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi gzhung lam yin/ / rnam rig bye mdo

160 grub mtha'i bstan bcos mi shig rdo rje'i go cha/gsum gyi grub pa'i mtha'/ / ma shes de yis dpal ldan dbu ma pa/ / rnam rig bye mdo gsum las mchog gyur zhes/ / smra ba dam bca' tsam du zad mthong nas/ / 'jigs bral bcom ldan shākya seng ge de'i/ / srol 'dzin bye mdo dbu sems rnam pa bzhi'i/ /grub mtha' lung rigs phrugs mas spel ba 'di/ / thub bstan phyogs brgyar gsal ba'i sgron me yin/ / kha cig grub mtha'i rnam bzhag mang bshad kyang / / rigs pas brtag na lha ba bzhin du sob/ / 'ga' zhig lung bral rtog bzo'i grub pa'i mtha'/ / smra 'di rna ba'i bdud rtsi min mthong nas/ / lung rigs mtshon cha'i 'khor lo 'bum spros kyang / / brjod bya'i lus la gnod pa mi nus pa'i/ / legs par bshad pa rdo rje'i go cha 'di/ / blo gsal gzhon nu'i dga' ba'i rgyan cha yin/ / lung rigs dwangs gtsang chu yis legs bkrus pa'i/ / legs bshad nor bu'i 'phrin las gzi 'od kyis/ / gdul bya'i blo yi mun pa rab gsal nas/ / mkhyen gnyis snang bas rtag tu 'tsho gyur cig ces pa 'di ni don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos na rdo rje 'chang chen dge slong gi rnam par sprul pa7mkhan chen yid bzhin gyi nor bu7don brgyud nyi ma zhes sa gsum na 'gran zla dang bral ba'i dpal ldan bla ma de'i zhabs kyi padmo spyi bor len pa'i skal bzang thob pa las gzhung lugs rgya mtsho lta bu la 'chad pa dang / rtsod pa dang / rtsom pa bcas kyi spobs pa mi dman pa kun bshad kyi btags ming la ngag dbang dbyangs can gtsug lag rgya mtsho lung rigs smra ba'i nyi ma'am thun mong du mkhan ming pa bstan pa rab rgyas zhes 'bod pas/ 'brug sdings che don grub mthong smon gling gi bshad grwa cog sgar lung rigs smra ba'i dga' tshal nas sbyar ba dge'o/ / bkra shis| / /

161༄tshosaran gyi tshul las 'phros pa'i gtam 'jam dpal dgyesapa'i bzhad sgra zhes bya ngasabazhugasa'asdo/'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhi bsil chos kyi sbrang char zegs ma res/ /blo gros spe tog mtha' yas bzhad mdzad pa'i/ /tshe rabs gtan gyi skyabs gnas rin chen gsum/ /bde chen 'khor lo'i rgyan du mdzes gyur cig /'phags yul mkhas pa'i zhal rgyun gtsang ma'i chab/ /blo gros gsal ba'i yol gor legs bcus nas/ /gshis bzang gzu bor gnas pa'i skal ldan la/ /'phang med sbyin nus 'di yang skal pa bzang /'dir 'thad ldan kyi lan gyi rnam bzhag dang 'thad ldan ma yin pa'i lan gyi rnam bzhag gnyis kyi rnam dbye cung zad bshad par bya ste/ de'ang da lta'i tha mal pa'i so so'i skye bo 'di rnams 'chi 'gyur ma yin no zer na/ de la ma grub ces lan 'debs rigs so/ de'ang skabs thob kyi sgo nas de 'dra'i dri ba'i gnad mtshungs rtags kyi thog tu khel tshe rtags ma grub pa'i lan dang / rtags gsal gnyis su phye gsal ba'i thog tu khel tshe gsal ba ma grub pa'i lan bcas gsal kha btod nas 'debs rigs so/ da lta'i dus na

162 grub mtha'i bstan bcos mi shig rdo rje'i go cha/'chi zin gyi gang zag rnams zag bcas kyi las nyon gyi stobs kyis rjes su srid par nying mtshams sbyor 'gyur yin nam zhes 'dri na/ de la ma nges zhes lan 'debs rigs so/ de'ang skabs thob kyi sgo nas de 'dra'i dri ba'i gnad mtshungs rtags kyi thog tu khel tshe rtags ma nges pa'i lan dang / rtags gsal gnyis su phye ba'i gsal ba'i thog tu khel tshe gsal ba ma nges pa'i lan dang / khyab lan gyi thog tu khel tshe khyab pa ma nges pa'i lan rnams gsal kha btod nas 'debs rigs so/ sgra rtag pa yin par thal/ sgra mi rtag pa yin pa'i phyir/ zer na/ de la khyab pa 'gal zhes lan 'debs rigs so/da lta'i tha mal pa'i so so'i skye bo 'di rnams 'chi 'gyur yin no/ zer na/de la 'dod ces lan 'debs rigs so/ de'ang skabs thob kyi sgo nas de 'dra'i dri ba'i gnad mtshungs rtags kyi thog dang / rtags gsal gnyis su phye ba'i gsal ba'i thog bcas gang du khel na'ang 'dod lan 'debs rigs so/ de lta bu'i lan 'debs tshul 'di la rigs pa'i gnod byed nam yang mi 'jug cing khyad chos bla na med pa ldan par ma zad khungs thub kyi gzhung chen mang po zhig 'di'i rgyab chos su rang nger bzhugs so/ de'ang dpe mtshon gyi tshul du kha shas shig drangs na/ mngon pa mdzod kyi rang 'grel las/ 'dri ba ni rnam pa bzhi ste/ mgo gcig tu lung bstan par bya ba dang / rnam par phye nas lung bstan par bya ba dang / dris nas lung bstan par bya ba dang/gzhag par bya ba'o/ de la go rim bzhin du/ mgo gcig dang ni rnam phyed dang / /dri dang gzhag par lung bstan pa/ / 'chi dang skye dang khyad par 'phags/ / bdag gzhan la sogs lta bu yin/ / bar rig par bya ste/ci sems can thams cad 'chi bar 'gyur ram zhes 'dri na/ 'chi bar 'gyur ro zhes mgo gcig tu lung bstan par bya'o/

lan gyi tshul du 'phros pa'i gtam/ 163ci sem/sa can thams cad skye bar 'gyur ram zhes 'dri na/ nyon mongs pa dang bcas pa rnams ni skye bar 'gyur gyi nyon mongs pa med pa rnams ni ma yin no zhes rnam par phye ste lung bstan par bya'o/ ci mi 'di khyad par du 'phags pa yin nam dman pa yin zhes 'dri na/ gang la ltos te 'dri zhes dris nas lung bstan par bya ste/ gal te lha rnams la ltos te'o zhes zer na ni dman no zhes lung bstan par bya'o/ 'on te ngan song rnams la ltos te'o zhes zer na ni khyad par du 'phags so zhes lung bstan par bya'o/ ci phung po rnams las sems can gzhan nam gzhan ma yin zhes 'dri na/ sems can gyi rdzas med pa'i phyir bzhag par bya ste/ mo sham gyi bu sngo bsangs sam dkar sham zhes bya ba bzhin no/ 'di ji ltar na lung ma bstan pa yin zhe na/ de ni lung ma bstan no zhes de lta bur lung du bstan pa'i phyir ro/ zhes dang /'brug mkhan chen mi pham pad ma dkar po'i zhal snga nas/ dri ba ni bzhi ste/mgo gcig tu lung bstan par bya ba dang ni rnam par phye ba dang / dris nas dang / bzhag par bya bas lung du bstan pa ste mtshan gzhi rim pa bzhin ci sems can thams cad 'chi bar 'gyur ram zhes dri na/ 'chi bar 'gyur ro zhes dang / ci sems can thams cad skye bar 'gyur ram zhe na/ nyon mongs pa dang bcas pa rnams ni skye bar 'gyur ro/ nyon mongs pa med pa rnams ni ma yin no zhes dang / ci mi 'di khyad par 'phags pa yin nam dman pa yin zhes dri na gang la bltos nas dris nas/ gal te lha rnams la bltos te zer na dman no/ 'on te ngan song rnams la bltos te zhes zer na khyad par du 'phags so zhes dang / ci phung po rnams las sems can bdag yin nam gzhan yin zhes pa la sogs pa dri na sems can gyi rdzas med pa'i phyir bzhag par bya ste/ mo sham gyi bu sngo bsangs sam dkar sham zhes bya ba

164 grub mtha'i bstan bcos mi shig rdo rje'i go cha/lta bu/ 'di lung bstan par ji ltar 'gro/ de ni lung mi ston no zhes de ltar lung bstan pas so/ zhes dang / sa skya paṇa chen gyi zhal snga nas kyang /lung la rtsod pa'i gnas skabs su/ / lung gi don la 'dri ba'am/ / min yang shin tu lkog gyur gyi/ / don la 'dri ba 'gal ba med/ / lung gi chos la rtsod pa na/ sde snod gsum gyi don tshul khrims dang shes rab dang ting nge 'dzin las bcoms te 'dri ba'am/ rgyud sde bzhi'i don smin par byed pa dang grol bar byed pa las brtsams te 'dri ba'am/ mdo rgyud nas ma gsungs pa lkog gyur gyi don skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum las gzhan dbang phyug la sogs pa'am/ lta ba bka' rtags kyi phyag rgya las gzhan bdag dang gang zag la sogs pa'am/ spyod pa dbu ma las gzhan bsod nyams dang ngal zhing dub pa la sogs pa las brtsams te 'dri'am ma rtogs pa dang log rtog dang the tshom gyi sgo nas 'dri na/ 'dri bar 'os pas bzhad gad kyi gnas ma yin no/ de'i lan yang / mdo las lan gdab rnam bzhi gsungs/ / mgo gcig rnam phye dri dang gzhag / rim bzhin 'chi dang skye ba dang / / bzang dang bdag gi yon tan sogs/ / bcom ldan 'das kyis lan gdab pa'i tshul bzhi gsungs te/ skyes pa thams cad 'chi mi 'chi/zhes 'dri na nges par 'chi zhes mgo gcig tu lan gdab/ shi ba thams cad skye mi skye zhes 'dri na bdag 'dzin can skye/ bdag 'dzin med na mi skye zhes rnam par phye ste lan gdab/ mir skyes pa bzang ngam zhes 'dri na gang la ltos zhes 'dri/ ngan 'gro la lto sa na bzang / lha la ltos na ngan zhes lan gdab/bdag rtag gam mi rtag ces 'dri na/ bdag ma grub pas de la rtag pa dang mi rtag pa gnyis ka mi 'grub bo zhes lan gdab/ ces pa nas/ dri ba kun la lan gyi rnam bzhag de ltar yin no zhes mdo las gsu ngas so/ zhes dang /

wa wa— lanagyisadu'aphros pa 'i gtam / 165'jam/ mgon sangs rgyas rdo rje'i zhal snga nas/ de ltar rgol ba snga phyi dri ba dang lan gyi sgo nas chos rnam par gtan la dbab tshul gyi snying po 'di lta ste/ngag gi lha mor gus btud nas / / ston dang bstan 'dzin dgongs pa'i mtsho/ /'dod dgu'i mdzod yin de ltar na'ang / / zab yangs rjes su 'di dpag bya/ / de yang snga mo zhig thos bsam pa'i khur len dus/ blo gsal gzhon nu mang po'i mchid la/ lan gdab pa dang / dgongs pa dang / ldem por dgongs pa sogs kyang ngos 'dzin dper brjod kyis brgyan pa zhig dgos shes gling ba dag la/ dris pa mtha' dag rigs lam nas rgyas bshad don du 'khril ba'i bshad pa mang du song yang / brjed thor 'god pa'i long skabs ma byung /da lam dal ba'i dal gtam mdo tsam brjod pa ni 'di yin te/ chos mngon pa mdzod las/ mgo gcig dang ni rnam phyed dang / /dri dang bzhag par lung bstan pa/ / 'chi dang skye dang khyad par 'phags/ / bdag dang gzhan la lta bu yin/ / zhes lan gdab tshul lam/ lung ston tshul bzhi gsungs pa'i dang po/ skyes pa thams cad 'chi'am mi 'chi zhes 'dri na 'chi zhes mgo gcig tu lan gdab/ shi ba thams cad skye mi skye zhes 'dri na/bdag 'dzin can skye/ bdag 'dzin med na mi skye zhes rnam par phye ste lan gdab/ mir skyes pa bzang ngam ngan zhes dri na gang la bltos nas shes dri/ngan 'gro la ltos na bzang / lha la bltos na ngan zhes lan gdab/ bdag rtag gam mi rtag ces dri na/ bdag ma grub pa de la rtag pa dang mi rtag pa gnyis ka ma grub bo zhes bzhag par lan gdab pa ste bzhi/ dper brjod pa de mtshon byed du byas nas/ bka' dang bstan bcos las byung ba'i dri ba dang lan gyi rnam bzhag gam/ 'jig rten gyi 'phral gtam lta bu la rgyas

166 grub mtha'i bstan bcos mi shig rdo rje'i bo cha/bkab kyang legs par thegs shing brjod pa gtsang bar 'gyur ro/ zhes gsungs so /de 'dra'i rnam/ thar sgo bzhi gang rung gi lan 'debs ma shes pa'i skyon cung tsam/ zhu na/ tshad ma kun btus las/ mngon sum dang ni rjes su dpag / tshad ma'o mtshan nyid gnyis gzhal bya/ / de la rab sbyor phyir tshad ma/ gzhan ni yod pa ma yin no/ zhes tshad ma la dbye na mngon rjes gnyis su drang nges mdzad kyang / kha cig gis/ tshad ma yin na mngon rjes gang rung yin pas ma khyab/ tshad ma chos can/ zhes smra ba dang / yang kha cig gis/ gser bum zangs bum gnyis las bum pa gang yang med pa'i sa phyogs na yod pa'i bum pa yin na gser bum zangs bum gnyis po gang rung yin pas ma khyab/ bum pa chos can/ zhes smra ba dang / tshad ma chos can/mngon rjes gang rung yin par thal/ zer ba la/ kha cig gis/ rdzas spyi ma zhes zer ba las rnam thar sgo bzhi gang rung gi dngos lan ma thebs pa bcas ni gong gsal gyi rnam thar sgo bzhi gang rung gi lan 'debs ma shes pa'i skyon la brten nas grub bo/gzhan yang kha cig gis / tha dad cing gzhi mthun mi srid pa yin na yod pa yin pas khyab cing yod pa dang med pa gnyis yod pa ma yin zhing yod pa dang med pa gnyis tha dad cing gzhi mthun mi srid pa yin zhes zer bzhin du/ yod pa dang med pa gnyis chos can/ tha dad cing gzhi mthun mi srid pa yin par thal/ zhes zer ba la/ 'dod lan 'debs par byed cing /yang de la/ yod pa dang med pa gnyis chos can/ yod pa yin par thal/tha dad cing gzhi ma thun mi srid pa yin pa'i phyir/ zhes zer ba la/ sbyor lugs skyon can zhes smra bar byed pa sogs ni/ rnam thar sgo bzhi gang rung gi

lan gyi tshul du 'phros pa'i gtam/ 167dngos la na ma thebs nas 'u thug pa'i lan ma yin nam drang por bas ma pa ra mdzod dang de das gi bzlog phyogs kyi sgo nas gong gsal gyi rnam thar sbo bzhi gang rung gi lan 'debs shes pa'i dge mtshan yang shes pa ra bya'o/gzhan yang kha cig nas/ sgra rtag pa yin par thal/ zhes pa'i thal 'gyur la/ ci'i phyir/ zhes lan btab pa pos/ sgra rtag pa ma yin par khas blangs pa yin par thal/ zer na/ rang lugs la 'dod mi rigs te/sgra rtag pa yin par thal/ zhes pa'i thal 'gyur la/ ci'i phyir/ zhes lan btab pa pos/ sgra rtag pa yin pa'i rgyu mtshan ci yin na/ zhes rgyu mtshan 'dren pa'i tshig bstan pa tsam las sgra rtag pa yin min ci yang khas blangs pa ma yin snyam mo/ / 'on kyang bod bsdus kyi lugs la ni ma gtogs so/ kye chos kyi grogs po lags 'dod pa mi 'dra ba cung zad mthong ba tsam gyis ha las nas spyan cher mi bgrad par/ legs cha cung zad mchis na gzu bo'iblo yis dang du len 'os pa ma yin nam/ / spyir 'u cag ston pa gcig pa'imached po rnams dang lhag par du kha ba'i ljongs na mchis pa'i dam tshig gcig pa'i dkar rnying sa gsum jo dge bo gsum sogs kyi lugs 'dzin pa rnams kyis rang lugs gtsor 'dzin pa'i khar phan tshun dag snang gi nor bu'i 'od kyis khyab par mdzad 'os pa ma yin nam/ /kye kye gson dang rgyal bstan sgor zhugs kyi grogs po/ /bdag cag las smon gcig pas bstan sgo la zhugs nas/ /phan tshun dag snang dkar pos 'od zhags kyis sgril te/ /bstan 'gror phan pa'i las la lhan cig tu brtson no/ /lhag bsam gangs ri dkar po zla 'od dang 'grogs te/ /legs bshad 'od kyi zesas ma/ phyogs kun tu spros pa'i/ /

rnam dkar 'od snang dkar pos gangs can gyi rig gzhung / /kha ba ri pa'i rgyan du bzhugs pa/ ru smon no/ /zhes pa 'di'ang sgyu ma lta bu'i chos tshul la gnas te mkhan ming pa shākya'i dge slong bstan pa rab rgyas sam ngag dbang dbyangs can gtsug lag rgya mtsho lung rigs smra ba'i nyi ma nas sbyar ba'o/ bkra shis bde legs// / /

169zhar byung /mdun shog ri mo'i mtshonican/de yang / 'ja' zer gyi thig le 'od phung gi klong du rgyal ba'i lung gis zin pa'i bod gangs can mtshon pa'i gangs ri dang yang de gsum gyis skyes mchog mar pa/ rje btsun mi la/ mnyam med dwags po rin po che ste dkar brgyud gong ma rnam gsum mtshon/ ri mo de'i g.yas g.yon gyi 'brug kha sprod kyis rgyal ba rdo 'chang nas 'phags bod kyi paṇa grub rim rgyud dang / de nas paṇa chen nā ro de nyid slar 'gro ba'i don du srid pa bzung ba'i tshul bstan pa chos rje gtsang pa rgya ras chen pos srol gtod pa'i mdo sngags zung 'brel gyi bstan pa dpal ldan 'brug pa bka' brgyud ces yongs su grags pa de'i mtshan don mtshungs pas de ltar mtshon/ 'brug gi rkang lag kha mig sogs ma tshang ba med pa dang / 'brug mgo mkhar stegs pa des bstan pa rin po che 'di nyid tshang la ma nor ba dri ma med pa mtshon/ 'brug kha mdog ser po ni rgyal ba'i mtshon don te/ 7rgyal ba'i bstan pa spyi dang bye brag dpal ldan 'brug pa'i bstan pa rin po che 'di nyid sngon bstan pa yar dar gyi skabs bya rgod po'i nyin lam bco brgyad kyi sar khyab pa byung bas/ 'dzam gling gi mi phyed 'brug pa/ 'brug phyed sprang po/ sprang phyed grub thob ces pa ltar slar bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams kyi thugs rje dang bka' drin la brten nas phan bde'i 'byung gnas bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas pa dang / skye

170 grub mtha'i bstan bcos mi shig rdo rje'i go cha/'gro thams cad bde skyid chos la spyod rgyu yong ba'i rten 'brel mtshon rtags/'brug gi sma ra dkar po dang / sgal ze mjug ma sogs dmar po/ sku dang ral pa ljang gu bcas kyis zhi drag dbang gi las thams cad kyang thogs med du 'grub pa'i rten 'brel mtshon pa/ ser 'brug gi lag pa'i nang du nor bu kha mdog dkar po/ ser po/ mthing gsum pos phyi so thar/ nang byang sems/ gsang ba sngags kyi theg pa rnams mtshon/ mtsho dbus kyi pad ma dkar po rab tu rgyas pas sangs rgyas gnyis pa pad ma 'byung gnas/'phags mchog phyag na pad mo sogs mtshon yang skabs 'dir kun mkhyen pad ma dkar po mtshon/ pad ma'i steng gi ral gri/ glegs bam/ nyi ma bcas kyis mkhan chen bka' drin can lung rig smra ba'i nyi ma gang de'i mtshan dang chos mtshungs pas de ltar bkod/yang nyi zla gnyis pos 'gro ba'i ma rig mun pa sel ba dang / thabs shes zung sbrel gyi mtshon byed yin/ nyi zla'i 'od zer gyis gdul bya phyogs med du khyab pa'i rten 'brel mtshon byed/ shes rab kyi ral gri rin chen de'i rtse dbus der rin chen beeḍūrya mtshan pa ni/ rigs bdag mkhan chen yid bzhin nor bu don rgyud nyi ma mchog mtshon pa yin/ 'brug gi lag dang po gnyis kyi 'khor lo dang sna tshogs rdo rje gnyis ni/ spyir sgron bskal dang mun bskal gnyis las sgron bskal mtshon pa ste bskal pa 'dir sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon pa dang / chos 'khor rim pa gsum gsungs pa/ de'i bstan pa nyams pa med par gnas pa ma zad/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang nas mkhan chen lung rigs smra ba'i nyi ba'i zhabs kyi dbar brgyud pa gser gyi nyag thag ma chad par gdul bya'i blo dang 'tshams pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol zhes gsol 'debs zhu ba'am yang na chos 'khor bar ma chad par bskor mdzad

zhar byung / 171nas sems can grangs med pa thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i lam la 'god bzhin pa mtshon pa'o/ sna tshogs rdo rje rgya gram gyi mtshon don ni/ rdo brag rgyas sras kun bzang rnam rgyal gsung las/ rdo rje rgya gram ni las bzhi lhun gyis 'grub pa'i mtshon rtags yin te/ mtshon byed dkar po ni/ lha klu gnod sbyin dri za la sogs pa'i gdon rnams las thar ba dang / glo bur ye 'brog dus min par 'chi ba sogs nad dang sdug bsngal bar chad thams cad dang nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sdig sgrib thams cad zhi ba'i mtshon rtags/ mtshon byed ser po ni/ tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor snyan grags gzi brjid lang mtsho zas nor longs spyod bu slob 'khor 'bangs mangs ris chos srid dar zhing rgyas pa dang / mkhye brtse mthu stobs nus rtsal nyams rtogs yon tan thams cad gong du 'phel ba dang / 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge legs kyi yon tan ji snyed pa thams cad dbyar gyi chu gter yar ngo'i zla ba bzhin du 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i mtshon rtags/mtshon byed dmar po ni/ 'jig rten khams kyi lha 'dre mi gsum rgyal blon btsun mo skye 'gro pho mo'i zas nor longs spyod dang / dreg ldan mi dang mi ma yin mtha' bzhi'i rgyal khams mtha' dag gi mthu bo che rang dbang med par mos pa rnams gzhis dbang du 'dud pa'i mtshon rtags/ mtshon byed ljang gu ni/ gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i gzugs can gzugs med sogs dgra gegs log 'dren 'byung po dam sri sgab 'dre mtha' bzhi'i dmag dpung byad ma lha srung bcas sa thams cad kyi gnod pa las grol zhing / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang sems can gyi bde skyid la 'tshe zhing byang chub sgrub pa la bar dugacod par byed pa'i ma rung gdug can bsam ngan sbyor rtsub tshang ba tshar gcod pa'i drag po'i 'phrin las mtshon rtags/ lte ba sngon po ni/ zhi rgyas

172 grub mtha'i bstan bcos mi shig rdo rje'i go cha/dbang drag las rab 'byams thogs med du thams cad lhun gyis 'grub pa'i mtshon rtags bcas so zhes dang / yang dbus kyi mtsho mo ni/ rgyal dang rgyal sras khyad par bka' brgyud gong ma rnams kyi thugs dgongs chu bo'i gzhung gcig tu 'khyil ba dang / der ngang ser sogs ci bder gnas bzhin rgyu ba ni/ gdul bya spyi dang lhag par bstan pa'i gzhi ma ngur mig 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun rnams mdo sngags rig gnas mtha' dag la thos bsam sgom gsum gyi bya ba la ngang pa pad mtshor 'jug pa lta bu'i dga' dad spro gsum gyi sgo nas spong klog 'khor lo gsum gyis dus 'da' ba'i rten 'brel mtshon rtags/ gsham gyi lha mas dar dkar ser lhab lhub ngang dga' 'khyil ler yod pa de gnyis kyi dkar po ni/ mchod yul de rnams la ma dad pa dang ma gus pa sogs sems nyon mongs pa'i dbang du ma shor bar dang 'dod yid ches kyi dad pa bcos ma ma yin pa'i sgo nas dkar gtsang gi lha reg dkar po lta bu bdag sogs kyi sems la nyon mongs kyi dri mas ma gos par lhag bsam chen po zhu ba'i mtshon rtags/ lha rdzas ser po ni/ bstan pa dang sems can la bka' drin che ba/ lhag par rang nyid la bka' drin che ba'ibla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la bka' drin mtshon par byed pa'i ched du lha mas ser po 'bul srol bcas mdun shog ri mo'i mtshon don mdor bsdus tsam zhig sems la rnam rtog gang dran gyis bris pa la/ yar lung lha bzo ba skyabs gsum 'dzin pa'i dge bsnyen phur bu tshe ring nas/

— 1yangazuradu gsal gad res 'di phyogs nas skyabs rje mkhan chen yid bzhin nor bu'i gsung gi cha shas tsam zhig rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi rgyar sngar legs skyes su 'bul thub pa ni/ sems bzang gi grogs po rnam pa dang / sku nyid kyi zhal slob/ dad can sbyin bdag bcas nas shugs che'i rgyab skyor gnang ba'i nus mthu las grub pa zhig lags/de yang gtso bo'i 'gan 'khur ba rgan bsam grub lags dang / lha bzo ba chen mo phur bu tshe ring lags/ lho kha mi dam/ngas dngul khang gi dbang rgyal lags/ lha sar bca' bzhugs dpa' mcho/ yig sgyur gnang mkhan mkhas grub chos 'phel lags dang mtshams gcod sgrol ma lags bcas nas shugs che'i rgyab skyor gnang ba dang / gzhan yang dpal 'byor thad nas rgyab skyor gnang mkhan gras su rgan tshe ring dbang chen dang / mgon po gang de'i zhal slob tu gyur ba mdo sngags bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan zhi chen kong sprul rin po che mchog nas sgor5000tham pa/ de bzhin zhal slob tu gyur ba'i lhag bsam can dpal ldan bstan 'dzin dang / ngag dbang chos rgyal/bstan 'dzin 'brug grags bcas gsum nas sgor3000tham pa/ lha sa nor srid thing gi nyi ma dbang phyug lags nas sgor1500tham pa/ lha sar bca' bzhugs dngos grub dang tshe ring nang tshang nas sgo ra1000tham pa/ gra nang snam 'tshong ba chen mo nyi ma rgyal mtshan dang pad ma 'od gsal sku mched gnyis dang / sgang stod phur bu bkris bcas gsum nas sgor3000tham pa bcas

phul sanang ba'i dase rtsar brten nas dad can sbyin pa'i bdag pos gtsos sems can thams cad gnas skabs kyi nye 'tshe tha dag zhi nas ma/thar thug rnam ma/khyen rdzogs byang thob pa ra bsngo rigs pa dang / ris med rgyal bstan spyi dang khyad par mnyam med dkar brgyud pa'i bstan pa phyogs brgyar rgyas pa'i rgyur 'gyur cig ces mgon po gang de'i drin gyis 'tsho ba'i shar phrug pas lha ldan nas// / /

nām sgrigā 'asbyi 'khur pa/ bsam gru1/ pa sprabasna dazlo ༵/ṭā gshā'i swā ba/hā pa/ ༵ ༵ /grub mtha'i bstanabacas mi thigardo rje'i go cha/:stub tta~X /༷ /sna kā sna rshatā rgyas/|stuX'istag nḍi rdorsha/ stu shlau /sna ṭwāṃ /| yilha snyam sgrig khang /sto 'chiya : rjisgotā ldasnru patna rnyibye tram̐ kau 〉sdo rshasdi ddhirsha jiju /ṭī mispogag bye/ ddhi par 'ashāsbyi da 731 kung si/rgyunt+ra gatheb mruX 0 01snang padū spru sdi /ji trī hā: /spya/ po brgyab/

gsolabadebasadrangasangangaden tshig zhes :rgya bkakhasanas /༄༅she sa ngag la dbang sgyur shes bya'i gnas la mkhas/ / dpal ldan 'brug pa'i ring lugs nyin mor 'byed/ /gangs can bstan pa 'dzin pa'i bshes gnyen ma chog / zhabs pad srid mtha'i bar du brtan par shog /so thar tshul khrims sa gzhi gtsang ma ru/ / byang sems ting 'dzin lam gyi myu gu rgyas/ / shes rab sku gsung 'bras bu g.yur za ba/ / bslab gsum rgyan gyi sbud de zhabs brtan gsol/ / dam pa'i yon tan kun la dbang 'byor zhingan / 'phags nor rin chen bdun gyis mngon par phyug / chos kyi mdzad pa srid gsum dbang gyur mgon/ / mkhan chen bstan pa rab rgyas zhabs brtan gsol/ / 'gro ba'i bla ma mtshungs zla bral ba'i sku/ /gsang ba gsum gyi gzi byin rab tu 'phro/ /dam chos bdud rtsis gdul bya chims mdzad pas/ /bshadaskyab bstan pa dar zhing rgyas 'gyur cig / bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs dngan / chos skyong ma mgonarnams kyi mthu stobs dngan / las 'bras bsru ba med pa'i bden pa'i mthus/ / smon lam btab tshad ji bzhin myur 'grub shog / gtsang shar phyogs mchog sprul ༵༵༵ /na rin po ches mdzad pa/ sarba mgi lo/ dge legasam 10rsā cha bye lo 7khro/4)/ rtsa/ 〉〉rnye77
